decks.notes: The deck revolves around casting a large number of spells in a single turn to generate enough storm count to cast Tendrils of Agony and win the game. It utilizes various fast mana sources such as Lotus Petal and Lion's Eye Diamond, along with powerful storm enablers like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Duress to protect the combo and ensure a clear path to victory. Burning Wish provides additional flexibility in accessing key cards from the sideboard when needed.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping into powerful Eldrazi creatures using lands like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It looks to apply constant pressure with efficient beaters like Glaring Fleshraker and It That Heralds the End, while also utilizing ways to generate additional Eldrazi tokens with cards like Sowing Mycospawn. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creature-based strategy and efficient mana base.

This deck focuses on using the combo of Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfling to generate infinite mana and draw cards. Nadu, Winged Wisdom is the key creature that enables this combo, allowing you to draw your entire deck and find a win condition. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to protect the combo. Green Sun's Zenith helps to find key pieces of the combo, while Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides additional value and life gain. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo quickly and overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, then use various reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to cheat them into play for a game-winning combo. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo, along with acceleration like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal. The inclusion of Archon of Cruelty can provide additional value and the addition of Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Troll of Khazad-dûm can offer additional options for the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain control of the game through disruptive spells and creature removal while applying pressure with efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Daze, and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, you can create windows of opportunity to land powerful creatures and close out the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student serves as a versatile card advantage engine, while cards like Brazen Borrower and Psychic Frog provide additional tempo plays to keep your opponent off balance.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent with Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and powerful creatures while also utilizing land disruption with cards like Wasteland and Glaring Fleshraker. The deck also has some utility lands and mana acceleration to ensure smooth gameplay and consistent threats. Overall, the strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game by leveraging the strength of Eldrazi creatures.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to stall the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, while using cards like Murktide Regent and Baleful Strix to maintain board presence. By utilizing a variety of spells and creatures, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and dictate the pace of the game, eventually securing victory through incremental advantage and efficient resource management.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bringing them back into play with Reanimate and Animate Dead. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while controlling the game with counter spells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing these cards efficiently, the deck aims to win the game through a powerful combination of combo and reanimation strategies.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying disruptive creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Spirit of the Labyrinth while utilizing Aether Vial to cheat them into play. It also utilizes powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect its own creatures. The deck includes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard to tutor for key pieces and maintain board presence. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in the deck's strategy.

The deck is focused on controlling the game through removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, as well as counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to generate advantage and disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck's win conditions come from Batterskull, Kaldra Compleat, and Stoneforge Mystic fetching various equipment. The mana base includes dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistent access to the colors needed for the spells in the deck.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while maintaining a quick and aggressive tempo. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Daze, you can control the game and prevent your opponent from setting up their win condition. Additionally, the deck includes various creatures like Orcish Bowmasters, Brazen Borrower, and Murktide Regent to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. With a mix of disruption and aggression, this Dimir Tempo deck aims to keep your opponent on their toes and secure victory through efficient plays and smart decision-making.

Utilize artifacts and mana ramp to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Mystic Forge and other key pieces such as Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith. The objective is to generate mana and card advantage through Mystic Forge's ability to play cards from the top of your library. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Urza's Saga to fetch important artifacts and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The focus is on efficiently setting up the combo while controlling the board and ultimately overwhelming the opponent with big plays.

This deck focuses on utilizing the combination of Mystic Forge, Karn, the Great Creator, and various artifacts to generate powerful synergies and potentially infinite combos. By using cards like Basalt Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Paradox Engine, players can generate mana and chain together powerful plays. The deck also includes disruption elements like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to control the opponent's strategies. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful artifact-based combos.

The deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Sundering Eruption, while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf. It aims to lock down the opponent's resources and finish the game quickly with powerful spells like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing. The strategy revolves around using fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to cast impactful spells ahead of schedule, overwhelming the opponent and securing a victory.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them for a devastating early game combo. By utilizing spells like Faithless Looting, Entomb, and Reanimate, along with creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with massive creatures. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect the combo. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to efficiently reanimate powerful creatures to quickly dominate the game.

The main theme of this deck revolves around generating mana quickly and efficiently, with cards like Rite of Flame, Seething Song, and Ruby Medallion. It also focuses on casting multiple spells in a turn to create explosive combos, using cards such as Bonus Round, Reckless Impulse, and Jeska's Will. The goal is to maximize the potential of cards like Wish and Burning Wish to search for key combo pieces, while being able to recur spells from the graveyard with cards like Past in Flames. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.
